name: input-pane
notes: Catches the long-standing 'input not visible' bug class: render_app clamps prompt_height against a reserved budget (1 messages row + separator + status + suggestions + 2 footer rows) so a composer can never push itself off screen. Five characters is a single content row, so the border row plus the model/mode status line make the block three rows tall — the clamp arithmetic is exercised.
